title: Robert F. Kennedy's 1968 letter to a UFO researcher
summary: Steven Greer tells of Robert F. Kennedy's 1968 letter to a UFO researcher, about 1968 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: writing to um a uh a UFO researcher back in ' 68. It's dated one month before they killed him.

plain: A UFO researcher, Steven Greer, describes a letter from the politician Robert F. Kennedy to a UFO researcher in 1968, linked to a group called the Amalgamated Flying Saucer Clubs of America. Greer says the letter is dated one month before, in his words, they killed Kennedy. If true, it would mean a leading politician was taking UFOs seriously just before his death.
